spreads.scene: On the left a small child sits up in bed with both arms stretched high overhead; on the right a cat stands in the same pose, front legs pushed forward and back arched high. Three horizontal bands: a pale morning sky band across the top, a bed and floor band through the middle, a warm ground band along the bottom.

On the left a small child leaps mid-air over a flat oval puddle, knees tucked; on the right a frog leaps in the same arc at the same height. Four horizontal bands: sky, a distant hedge, wet ground with two flat puddles, and a dark foreground band of grass.

On the left a small child kneels and digs into the earth with both hands, a small mound of soil beside her; on the right an armadillo digs in the same kneeling posture with a much larger mound. Three horizontal bands: a flat sky, a mid band of dry field, and a thick dark band of turned earth in the foreground.

left.en: Nuna climbs up to the branch.

right.pt-BR: O macaco sobe até o topo.
right.en: The monkey climbs to the top.

spreads.scene: On the left a small child clings to a low thick branch, one leg hooked over it; on the right a monkey hangs from a much higher branch in the same hooked pose. Four horizontal bands: sky at the top, a canopy of flat leaf shapes, a band of trunks, and a shaded ground band.

right.en: The ant carries a bigger leaf.
right.es-MX: La hormiga carga una hoja mayor.

spreads.scene: On the left a small child walks leaning sideways, carrying a heavy bucket with both hands; on the right a single large ant walks in the same leaning posture carrying one enormous leaf above it. Three horizontal bands: sky, a long field band, and a foreground path band.

On the left a small child floats on her back, arms spread wide, seen from above on flat water; on the right a fish lies in the same spread-out silhouette but tilted, mid-turn. Three horizontal bands: a band of bank grass at the top, a wide flat water band through the middle, and a darker deep-water band at the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Nuna se esconde atrás da folha.
left.es-MX: Nuna se esconde tras la hoja.

spreads.scene: On the left a small child crouches behind one oversized flat leaf, only her head and boots showing; on the right a stick insect stands among identical twigs, almost indistinguishable from them. Four horizontal bands: sky, tall stems, a dense band of foliage, and dark ground.

left.en: Nuna sings loud in the yard.
left.es-MX: Nuna canta fuerte en el patio.

spreads.scene: On the left a small child stands with head tipped back and chest out, mouth a single small stroke; on the right a thrush perches on a wire in exactly the same tipped-back posture. Three horizontal bands: a wide warm sky, a band of low rooftops, and a yard band at the bottom.

On the left a small child runs at full stretch, one leg forward and one back; on the right a lizard runs in the same stretched silhouette, already touching the wall. Three horizontal bands: a flat brick wall filling the upper half, a narrow band of weeds, and a warm ground band.

left.en: Nuna builds a house of twigs.

right.en: The ovenbird builds his from mud.
right.es-MX: El hornero la hace de barro.

spreads.scene: On the left a small child kneels beside a small leaning shelter built of straight twigs; on the right a bird stands beside a round closed mud nest on a fence post, in the same kneeling-proud posture. Four horizontal bands: pale sky, distant trees, a fence line, and a foreground ground band.

On the left a small child stands on tiptoe with both arms opened wide and straight, heels lifted off the ground; on the right a heron is airborne with wings opened in exactly the same wide straight line, well above the ground. Four horizontal bands: a tall dusk sky, a distant tree line, a field band, and a low foreground band.

left.pt-BR: Nuna fecha os olhos. Boa noite.
left.es-MX: Nuna cierra los ojos. Buenas noches.

spreads.scene: On the left a small child lies curled on her side in bed, eyes closed as two short flat strokes; on the right the same backyard at night, every animal from the book curled and still in the same direction. Three horizontal bands: a deep night sky, a band of dark foliage, and a sleeping ground band at the bottom.

cover_scene: A small child stands on a grassy knoll, facing forward, with a frog, a cat, and a lizard looking up at her from the ground.
